cards.ex: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today, so I'm staying home.
cards.exUz: Bugun o'zimni biroz kasalmand his qilyapman, shuning uchun uyda qolaman.
cards.uzDef: O'zini biroz kasal his qilish, yaxshi emaslik.

cards.ex: The doctor gave me a clean bill of health after my check-up.
cards.exUz: Shifokor tekshiruvdan so'ng menga sog'lom ekanligimni aytdi.
cards.uzDef: Tibbiy tekshiruvdan so'ng hech qanday kasallik alomati yo'qligi.

cards.ex: I'm trying to fight off a cold with plenty of rest and fluids.
cards.exUz: Ko'p dam olish va suyuqlik ichish orqali shamollashga qarshi kurashishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik yoki infeksiyaga qarshi immunitet bilan kurashish.

cards.ex: She's been sick, but she's finally on the mend.
cards.exUz: U kasal edi, lekin nihoyat tuzalmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikdan keyin sog'ayish jarayonida bo'lish.

cards.ex: It took me a while to get over the flu.
cards.exUz: Menga grippdan tuzalib ketish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik yoki muammolardan xalos bo'lish, tuzalish.

cards.ex: I've been feeling really run-down lately, I need a vacation.
cards.exUz: Oxirgi paytlarda o'zimni juda holsiz his qilyapman, menga ta'til kerak.
cards.uzDef: Charchagan, energiya yetishmasligi va kasallikka moyil bo'lish.

cards.ex: I woke up with a splitting headache this morning.
cards.exUz: Bugun ertalab qattiq bosh og'rig'i bilan uyg'ondim.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli, qattiq bosh og'rig'i.

cards.ex: I have a sore throat, so I'm drinking lots of tea.
cards.exUz: Mening tomoq og'rig'im bor, shuning uchun men ko'p choy ichyapman.
cards.uzDef: Tomoqning qizarishi va og'riqli bo'lishi.

cards.ex: Running is a great way to burn calories.
cards.exUz: Yugurish - kaloriya yoqishning ajoyib usuli.
cards.uzDef: Mashqlar yoki harakatlar orqali energiyani sarflash.

cards.ex: Eating healthy foods can boost your immune system.
cards.exUz: Sog'lom ovqatlar iste'mol qilish immunitetni oshirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Immunitet tizimini kuchaytirish, kasalliklarga qarshi kurashish qobiliyatini yaxshilash.

cards.ex: I think I'm starting to catch a cold.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, men shamollay boshlayapman.
cards.uzDef: Shamollash kasalligiga chalinmoq.

cards.ex: She came down with the flu last week.
cards.exUz: U o'tgan hafta grippga chalingan edi.
cards.uzDef: Qandaydir kasallik bilan og'rib qolish.

cards.ex: He's in good shape because he exercises regularly.
cards.exUz: U muntazam ravishda mashq qilgani uchun yaxshi formada.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lom va jismoniy jihatdan yaxshi holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: I have a check-up with the doctor next week.
cards.exUz: Keyingi hafta shifokor bilan tekshiruvim bor.
cards.uzDef: Shifokor tomonidan umumiy salomatlik tekshiruvi.

cards.ex: I try to work out three times a week.
cards.exUz: Men haftada uch marta mashq qilishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Jismoniy mashqlar bilan shug'ullanmoq.

cards.ex: I need to cut down on sugar.
cards.exUz: Men shakar iste'molini kamaytirishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir miqdorini kamaytirish, odatda sog'liq uchun.

cards.ex: It's important to stay healthy by eating well and exercising.
cards.exUz: To'g'ri ovqatlanish va mashq qilish orqali sog'lom bo'lish muhim.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni sog'lom saqlash, sog'lig'ingizga g'amxo'rlik qilish.

cards.ex: This medicine will help ease the pain.
cards.exUz: Bu dori og'riqni yengillashtirishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Og'riqni kamaytirish yoki yo'q qilish.

cards.ex: I felt faint after standing in the sun for too long.
cards.exUz: Quyoshda juda uzoq turganimdan keyin o'zimni hushdan ketayotgandek his qildim.
cards.uzDef: Hushdan ketishga yaqin ekanligini his qilish.

cards.ex: He has a healthy appetite and always finishes his plate.
cards.exUz: Uning ishtahasi yaxshi va har doim taomni oxirigacha yeydi.
cards.uzDef: Ovqatga yaxshi ishtiyoq, ko'p ovqat yeyishga moyillik.

cards.ex: A balanced diet is important for good health.
cards.exUz: Muvozanatli ovqatlanish yaxshi sog'liq uchun muhim.
cards.uzDef: Barcha zarur oziq moddalarni o'z ichiga olgan ovqatlanish.

cards.ex: You need to take your medicine every day.
cards.exUz: Siz har kuni dorilaringizni ichishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Davolanish uchun dori vositalaridan foydalanish.

cards.ex: You should get some rest if you're feeling tired.
cards.exUz: Agar o'zingizni charchagan his qilsangiz, dam olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tana va aql uchun dam olish.

cards.ex: Weightlifting can help you build up strength.
cards.exUz: Og'ir atletika sizga kuch to'plashga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Mushaklar va jismoniy kuchni oshirish.

cards.ex: It's important to stay hydrated, especially in hot weather.
cards.exUz: Ayniqsa, issiq havoda suv ichib turish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Tanani yetarli miqdorda suv bilan ta'minlash.

cards.ex: Having a regular exercise routine can improve your health.
cards.exUz: Muntazam mashqlar rejasiga ega bo'lish sog'lig'ingizni yaxshilashi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Har kuni yoki haftada bir necha marta takrorlanadigan mashqlar rejasi.

cards.ex: I need to get a flu shot every year.
cards.exUz: Men har yili grippga qarshi ukol olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Immunitetni oshirish uchun in'ektsiya qilinmoq.

cards.ex: Yoga can help you relieve stress.
cards.exUz: Yoga sizga stressni kamaytirishga yordam berishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Stressni pasaytirish yoki yo'q qilish.

cards.ex: I need to get a prescription from the doctor.
cards.exUz: Menga shifokordan retsept olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Shifokor tomonidan yozilgan dori vositalari ro'yxati.

cards.ex: One side effect of this medicine is drowsiness.
cards.exUz: Bu dorining bir yon ta'siri - uyquchanlik.
cards.uzDef: Dori vositasining kutilmagan ta'siri.
